errors.evidence: The categories are not sorted in alphabetical order. For example, the last category, 'Не ми е известно...', starts with 'Н', which would place it after the categories starting with 'Д' in Bulgarian alphabetical order, but it is listed last. The order of categories appears to be arbitrary, not alphabetical.

errors.text_span: Стойностите са посочени с цифри вдясно от всеки стълб.
errors.evidence: The numerical values for each category are not shown next to the bars. They are listed to the right of the category labels in the legend area, which is to the left of the bar chart itself.

The description correctly identifies the lowest value (10) but misidentifies its color as pink ('розов'). In the chart legend, the category with value 10 ('Не ми е известно / Нямам инф...') is associated with a magenta/fuchsia color, not pink.
